Class GameController

java.lang.Object
com.trashslammers.controller.GameController
All Implemented Interfaces:
javafx.fxml.Initializable
public class GameController extends Object implements javafx.fxml.Initializable
Controller for the main game screen, where the player sorts falling trash into the right bins to earn points.
